# Khurshid Lab

> The Khurshid Lab at Sanford Research (Sioux Falls, SD) is a cancer biology lab led by Principal Investigator Dr. Safiya Khurshid. The lab studies dysregulated alternative RNA splicing in cancer — how aberrant isoforms drive tumor progression and therapy resistance — with a focus on pediatric cancer, RNA-binding proteins, and the MDM2/p53 pathway, using long-read sequencing to characterize tumor-specific isoforms and identify targeted therapies.

The website is a single page (https://www.khurshidlab.com) organized into the sections below.

## Sections

- [About](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#about): Dr. Safiya Khurshid's background and the lab's mission, philosophy, and core expertise (cancer genetics, tumor microenvironment, RNA biology, alternative splicing).
- [Research](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#research): Research focus on alternative splicing dysregulation in cancer and the lab's experimental approaches.
- [Publications](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#publications): Peer-reviewed publications from the lab, with search and filtering.
- [News](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#news): Latest lab news, awards, conference talks, and personnel updates.
- [Team](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#team): Current lab members and their roles.
- [Positions](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#positions): Open positions and how to inquire about joining the lab.
- [Contact](https://www.khurshidlab.com/#contact): Contact information for the lab.

## Topics

- Alternative RNA splicing in cancer
- Cancer biology and pediatric cancer
- RNA-binding proteins
- MDM2 and the p53 pathway
- Long-read RNA sequencing and isoform discovery
- Tumor progression and therapy resistance
